name: PC-Control
description: Lets an agent see and operate Windows apps without taking focus or moving the mouse. Click, type, key, drag, steps and open_app are reviewed. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep click, type, key, drag, steps and open_app on review: they can press buttons, write text, run shortcuts and start programs on the desktop. steps runs several of those in one call.
Use PC-Control's own permission modes (ask or strict) so protected windows such as terminals and password managers always ask first.
Install an exact version from PyPI, for example pip install claude-pc-control==0.7.7, and run pc-control status to see which mode is active.
